title: Skipjack deploy canvas + interim checkpad (Apr 2026) - WIP
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight deploy canvas for 'Skipjack' feature rollouts — meant to be used as the day-of checkpad and interim notes for the first 48h after canary. Unpolished, intentionally terse. Use this as the single source during shift handoffs.

Scope:
- Applies to hosted API and Dedicated routing changes (model routing + cache hints). Not for infra-only kernel updates.
- Aim: gradual traffic migration, 2-stage canary -> ramp, with automatic fallback on SLA/quality regressions.

High-level timeline (anchor dates, local times UTC):
- 2026-04-12 08:00 — Preflight: run smoke suite on staging, pre-regen of caches, ensure signal retention pipeline healthy.
- 2026-04-12 12:00 — Canary deploy (1% global): route to skipjack variant + tracing flags on.
- 2026-04-12 12:15-14:00 — Canary observation window (primary watch): latency, error-rate, correctness evals on 20 prompt seeds.
- 2026-04-12 15:00 — Decision checkpoint: cutover to 10% if green, otherwise rollback.
- 2026-04-13 09:00 — Ramp to 30% (if stable).
- 2026-04-14 09:00 — Full roll (95%) or pause for followups.

Preflight checklist (must be green before canary):
- [ ] Staging smoke: 1000 simulated requests, p95 latency < 180ms, error rate < 0.1%
- [ ] Telemetry ingestion sanity: no backlog > 5min (observability team signoff)
- [ ] Canary credentials/secrets validated, KMS keys rotated in test cluster
- [ ] Rollout config in console checked: correct rollout window, fallback model IDs pinned
- [ ] Incident channel created: #deploy-skipjack (ops on-call added)
- [ ] Run eval suite "skipjack-regression-quick" against current baseline (baseline -> new) and capture owned metrics

Canary watchlist (primary signals):
- Latency p50/p95/p99 by region (spike >= 30% from baseline triggers alert)
- Error rate (4xx/5xx) overall and by route (+0.5% absolute from baseline triggers decision)
- Quality regressions: automated eval set failing more than 2 prompts with confidence delta > 0.15
- Resource signals: GPU memory pressure > 85% sustained 1m
- Customer-facing errors (rate of user-visible exceptions > baseline + 0.2%)

Rollforward / Rollback decision matrix (cheat sheet):
- Immediate rollback if: fatal increase in 5xxs, model producing sensitive hallucination patterns on QA seeds, or resource exhaustion.
- Hold and triage if: latency increases but errors stable — engage perf team, reduce concurrency/batching, attempt quick config revert.
- Rollforward if: 30m stable canary, no QA regressions, telemetry post-check green.

Fast rollback steps (1-2-3):
1) Flip routing policy in console to previous model variant (manual failover)
2) Revert any config toggles (KV caching flags, quantization override)
3) Notify #deploy-skipjack, escalate to SRE if rollback doesn't reduce 5xx within 5m

Communication plan:
- Preflight: email to stakeholders + link to confluence canvas 24h before (PM, CS, SRE, infra)
- Canary: Slack status updates at start, 30m, 60m. Use format: [time] [status] [key-metrics] [next-step]
- Post-rollback: incident stub with timeline, immediate debrief within 2h

Post-release quick notes template (fill during shift):
- Start time:
- Canary -> ramp timeline:
- Observed anomalies (timestamps):
- Actions taken (who, what):
- Root cause hypothesis (if any):
- Followups for next shift / owners:

Open questions / unresolved items:
- Need to confirm how Dedicated routing respects the new cache-hint header (Ping infra team @Priya)
- Should we enable backfill of the KV cache for model-v2 on ramp? Risk: increased write pressure to redis cluster.
- Automaic rollback thresholds need iteration — current +0.5% error is conservative; product ok? (ask PM)

Sticky notes / quick hacks (on-call friendly):
- If p95 spikes but p50 steady: try temporarily lowering batch size on skipjack-pool via config -> reduces latency at cost of compute.
- If telemetry ingestion lags: use the short-term sampling flag to reduce event payload size for 15m window.

Postmortem / retro prompts (to populate after 48h):
- What worked well?
- What surprised us?
- Action items (owner + due date)
- Signal reliability improvements to add to preflight checklist

Files to attach during run (links we use):
- quick-evals: confluence://evals/skipjack-regression-quick
- runbook: confluence://runbooks/rollback-quick-flip
- smoke-suite results: GCS://redwood-smoke/skipjack/2026-04-12

Short-term next steps (today):
- Omar to validate Dedicated routing config by 2026-04-05 EOD
- Priya to triage KV backfill stress test in staging by 2026-04-06
- Maya to upload canary prompt seeds and baseline snapshots to the eval dashboard by 2026-04-08

Notes to self (untidy):
- Keep this doc as the one-line-of-truth for the 48h window. If making edits tag timestamp + initials.
- If we do an emergency rollback, capture the exact console commands in the postmortem.

---

End of canvas.
